en.title: Why Did Europe's Clocks Run 6 Minutes Late? ⏰ #Shorts
en.description:
In 2018 a dispute between Kosovo and Serbia slowed Europe's whole grid a hair: 49.996 instead of 50. Clocks that count the grid's pulse fell six minutes behind in 25 countries. And Japan has been split in two since 1895: 50 and 60.
